description: The ground plan of a village (core src/editor/layout/ground-plan.ts; the Unreal plugin's BYOA B5 - B8 ground, characterised from its Portable code). Brightwater Vale's roads, footpaths, plaza and lots as strips and rectangles; its lots graded flat into its terrain (pads at each lot's mean height, blended back over 4 m; a finer grid; every node lifted by the change under it); the yards and footpaths following the settled houses (a door's path to the street ahead of it) and the square's lanterns at the footpaths' mouths; plant props kept off the paving; generated plants trimmed off the layer's area, the paving and the lots by a margin that grows with them, and off solid things. Plan frame: IR (x, z) metres.

sources.characterisedBy: insimul-unreal tools/verify-unreal insimul_layout_characterise (Source/InsimulEditor/Tests/layout_characterise.cpp), the Portable code of unreal origin/main 6caede7 (BYOA B0-B8)
sources.pairing: BYOA B8 round 5 (unreal/byoa/state/byoa-b8/round-5): houses by role, the 6 m neighbour gap, the seat sinks, the 2.01 m cast, MI_Landscape_01a's layers and its ground paint

cases.name: plan: Brightwater Vale
cases.note: two lanes, a plaza, seven footpaths and seven lots on their street headings

cases.name: plan: widths and lots unstated
cases.note: a road of no width is 4 m, a footpath 2 m; an unbounded lot is no lot; a lot with no frontage runs along +x from the node

cases.name: grade: Brightwater's lots into its terrain
cases.note: seven pads at their lots' mean heights (sorted by lot), the graded grid at 1 m, and every building and prop lifted by the change under it (to the millimetre)

cases.name: grade: a terrain 1,900 m wide grades at 1,901 points a side
cases.note: 1 m cells over the longer side, plus one: under the 2,049-point cap

cases.name: grade: a terrain 2,100 m deep grades at the cap of 2,049 points
cases.note: 2,101 points wanted over the longer side (z); held at the cap

cases.name: follow: Brightwater's yards and footpaths follow its settled houses
cases.note: each yard moves with its house; each footpath runs from a step out of its door to the street ahead (a lane, or the square's plaza), 0.6 m into it

cases.name: follow: a door with no street ahead
cases.note: the lane is behind the door: the path moves with the settle as it stood; a building with no lot is left as it is

cases.name: follow: a street 13.5 m ahead of the door is reached
cases.note: within the 14 m a footpath reaches: it runs from the step out of the door to the lane, 0.6 m into it

cases.name: follow: a street 14.5 m ahead of the door is beyond reach
cases.note: past the 14 m a footpath reaches: it moves with the settle as it stood

cases.name: follow: a street 0.23 of its distance forward of the door is not ahead
cases.note: under a quarter of its distance forward: not a street ahead, so the path moves with the settle

cases.name: follow: a street 0.27 of its distance forward of the door is ahead
cases.note: a quarter or more forward: the footpath runs to it, 0.6 m into it

cases.name: mouths: Brightwater's followed footpaths
cases.note: each footpath's street end and the way it runs

cases.name: lanterns: the square's four at the footpaths' mouths
cases.note: Brightwater's square lanterns (no building's), nearest pairs first, each beside its path just short of the street

cases.name: lanterns: nearest first, beyond reach left
cases.note: the nearer of two lanterns takes a mouth; the other takes the next; one beyond 4.5 m is not moved

cases.name: lanterns: one 4.3 m from a mouth is moved to it
cases.note: within the 4.5 m a lantern pairs with a mouth: it moves beside the path, just short of the street

cases.name: lanterns: one 4.7 m from a mouth is left
cases.note: past the 4.5 m: no pair, the lantern is not moved

cases.name: plant props: off Brightwater's paving
cases.note: decision 18 for plant props: a tree in the square and a bush on a lane are not placed; a planter is not a plant; the meadow's tree stays

cases.name: trim: a generated layer over Brightwater's village
cases.note: the grass layer's area (its stated rows' 4 m cells grown by one), the followed plan, the settled houses and the well and stalls as solid things; a lattice of generated points of several sizes

cases.name: trim: the same layer, with the look's clearings
cases.note: a kept point is thinned out of a clearing at clumping 0.5 over 12 m clumps (a bound PCG graph's output)

cases.name: look density: Brightwater's rows near the square
cases.note: the B8 look: each row and three neighbours within 3.5 m, kept off the followed plan and the solid things

cases.name: look density: Brightwater's rows near the square, clumped
cases.note: density 4 x the clump weight at each row: clumps gain neighbours, clearings keep the row alone

cases.name: look density: 0.95, clumped, is not clumped
cases.note: at or under a density of 1 the clumping is not applied: the stable hash keeps 95% of the rows

cases.name: look density: 1.05, clumped, is clumped
cases.note: over a density of 1: 1.05 x the clump weight at each row, at least the row itself

cases.name: look density: half the rows, no plan, a small terrain
cases.note: below 1 a stable hash keeps about half the rows (none gain neighbours); with no plan only the paving and the solid things keep a neighbour off; a neighbour off a 200 m terrain is dropped

cases.name: look density: rows on a lane
cases.note: neighbours on the followed plan's strips are rejected and keep the row's yaw; the kept ones turn

cases.name: look density: rows on a lane, no plan
cases.note: no plan: the paving nodes reject the neighbours on the lane (on-road)

cases.name: props density: 0.6 of Brightwater's dressing stands
cases.note: the look's props.density: a stable hash of each prop's id leaves the same ones out on every import

cases.name: props density: 1 stands every prop
cases.note: the look's props.density: a stable hash of each prop's id leaves the same ones out on every import

cases.name: props density: 0.95 of Brightwater's dressing stands
cases.note: the look's props.density: a stable hash of each prop's id leaves the same ones out on every import

cases.name: look neighbours: over Brightwater's village
cases.note: the same rule without the layer's area

cases.name: look neighbours: no plan
cases.note: no paving known: only the solid things

cases.name: stated rows: inside a house or a prop
cases.note: a world-stated row stands unless it is inside one (no margin)

cases.name: distances: Brightwater's strips and lots
cases.note: <= 0 on a strip; 0 inside a lot

cases.name: margins: by a plant's radius
cases.note: 0.5 m + r/3 (at most 3 m) off what is built; 0.2 m + r/3 (at most 1 m) off solid things
